name: phishing_triage
title: Email phishing & social-engineering triage
description: Inspect structured email headers, authentication results (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), links, attachments, collaboration metadata, and body text to decide whether the email is phishing and what it asks the recipient to do.
writes: a realistic inbound corporate email with headers, authentication results, links, attachments, and body text

fields.headers: From display name, From address, Reply-To address, To/CC recipients, and Subject line
fields.auth: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC verification results (pass, fail, softfail, none)
fields.signals: Pre-parsed structural checks (domain mismatches, lookalike domains, sharer org alignment, recipient org spread)
fields.links_and_attachments: Extracted URLs with anchor text and registrable domains, plus attachment filenames and MIME types
fields.body: The plain-text body of the email, including any quoted reply history or collaboration notification text

ask: Is this email a phishing attempt, social-engineering attack, or malicious lure?
Does this email exhibit phishing, spoofing, business email compromise, or deceptive credential/payment harvesting?

labels.yes: Phishing, brand or executive impersonation, lookalike or mismatched link/reply-to domains, failed authentication on a claimed domain, suspicious external SaaS sharing lure, or unsolicited credential/payment/malware harvesting
labels.no: Legitimate transactional, operational, SaaS notification, vendor, or internal message where sender domain, authentication, links, sharer context, and requested action are consistent and benign

ask: What primary physical or UI action does the email ask the recipient to take?
Which interaction is the recipient prompted to perform?

labels.click_link: Follow a URL or button in the email body
labels.open_attachment: Open, download, or extract an attached file
labels.reply_with_info: Reply by email or message with requested information, approvals, or payment actions
labels.none: Informational only; no link click, attachment open, or reply is requested

ask: What sensitive asset, access, or commitment is the email ultimately asking for?
What is the underlying ask or target of the message?

labels.credentials: Sign in, verify an account, reset a password, enter an MFA/OTP code, or grant OAuth permissions
labels.payment_details: Pay an invoice, wire funds, update bank/IBAN/ACH routing details, or purchase gift cards
labels.document_access: Open, view, comment on, or sign a shared cloud document, spreadsheet, or e-signature envelope
labels.personal_info: Provide PII, tax IDs, SSN/NI numbers, payroll records, HR beneficiary details, or confidential business data
labels.software_install: Run an executable/script, open a macro/archive/HTML smuggling attachment, or install a tool/extension
labels.nothing: No sensitive asset, login, payment, document access, or installation is requested

ask: Does the sender claim to represent a trusted brand, executive, internal team, or known vendor?
Is the message relying on an explicit organizational, platform, or authority identity claim?

labels.yes: Claims to come from an IT/security desk, SaaS platform, executive, HR/finance team, bank, courier, or established vendor
labels.no: Makes no special authority or institutional identity claim

ask: Does the email apply time pressure, urgency, or threat of negative consequences?
Is there urgent deadline pressure or coercive language pushing immediate action?

labels.yes: Demands immediate or same-day action, warns of account lock/suspension, overdue penalties, legal/regulatory deadlines, or urgent executive need
labels.no: Uses a calm, routine timeline without artificial urgency or threats

ask: How should the email security pipeline route this message?
What is the appropriate Stage-1 triage disposition for this email?

labels.deliver: Deliver normally to the recipient's inbox (consistent sender/auth/links and benign context)
labels.enrich_links_or_attachments: Hold briefly for automated URL detonation or attachment sandboxing before delivery
labels.hold_for_review: Escalate to System-2 analyst review or out-of-band sender verification (e.g. BEC/payment/PII request)
labels.quarantine: Block or quarantine immediately due to clear spoofing, malicious lure, or credential/malware harvesting
